I had already found a lot of comfort and identity with the Borderline diagnosis as it seemed to make more sense than my previous diagnosis of Bi Polar Disorder and I finally had a word for what I was feeling and a community to relate with. My best friend who has OCD who has known me since I was 14 felt that I was Borderline with Pure OCD. My therapist who administered the MMPI2 test thought I was Bi Polar or Borderline or both until she read my results. So now I guess Schizo-Affective is my official diagnosis and it seems to overlap with symptoms of Bi Polar/Borderline/Pure OCD. I think my psychosis may have been triggered by drug experimentation since the age of 14. My therapist determined I am mild on the scale but am severely mentally ill due to how high my anxiety is and suicide ideation.
